g_ir.name: objective_diff_weight_all_pairs
g_ir.intuition: Weight each winner/loser pair by the absolute difference in objective values, using lower objective as winner (with tie-breaker on lower log_prob) to correct winner/loser semantics.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    log_prob = feature_cache['log_prob']
    # lower objective is better; tie-break with lower log_prob
    mask = (objective[:, :, None] < objective[:, None, :]) | ((objective[:, :, None] == objective[:, None, :]) & (log_prob[:, :, None] < log_prob[:, None, :]))
    b_idx, i, j = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    winner_idx = i
    loser_idx = j
    weight = (objective[b_idx, winner_idx] - objective[b_idx, loser_idx]).abs() + 1e-6
    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weight, meta={'builder': 'objective_diff_weight_all_pairs'})
